stackDivergence.rationale: Task177 implements actual plain OASIS ManifestExport over reused PropertyValue/Any/OUString and native comphelper AttributeList plus erased SAX method contracts. Preserve root scan early completion,16OASIS MIME choices,lexical version thresholds,source property/attribute/event order,nonempty entry versions,int64 Size,failed Any extraction destinations,duplicates and retained list values. Worker-safe browser SAX composition serializes exact attribute character values without DOM or a fabricated native Writer service. Writer supplies its own stream/font policy to the same exporter;the removed Writer-only shared export helper has no compatibility alias. Existing Writer import validation stays explicitly bounded pending native ManifestImport;full generic import,encrypted/legacy export,UNO ABI/services and complete ODS document/model/UI remain pending. Immutable native MIME literal contents use JS strings at browser/package boundaries;GC owns physical AttributeList objects and existing OUString/Any value semantics are reused without a new lifetime framework. Extracted actual ODS fixture manifest metadata is checked separately from its ZIP64 package and is not a document round trip or claimed native QA suite port. Whole-class/module parity stays unverified.
